content: Cargo.toml (doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/manifest.html + workspaces.html): [package] section — name is the ONLY field required by Cargo (version/description optional; registry may require more); version/description are plain strings; authors/keywords/categories are ARRAYS; edition/rust-version quoted strings; publish = false unquoted bool; workspace inheritance: member crates write version.workspace = true / description.workspace = true / edition.workspace = true (dotted keys, MSRV 1.64+), values inherit from [workspace.package] at workspace root; root manifest may combine [workspace] + [package]; virtual manifest = [workspace] WITHOUT [package] (no name/version); [dependencies], [dev-dependencies], [features] etc. are separate sections; cargo requires [package] to be the first section.
